from pathlib import Path
import ast, importlib.util, re

path = Path('/work/textmask.py')
source = path.read_text()
compile(source, str(path), 'exec')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('textmask', path)
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

def old_masked(text: str, name: str) -> str:
    t = text.lower()
    for tok in sorted({name} | set(name.split('-')), key=len, reverse=True):
        if len(tok) >= 3:
            t = re.sub(r'\b' + re.escape(tok) + r'\b', 'x', t)
    return t

cases = [
    ('Alpha-beta and alpha and beta.', 'alpha-beta'),
    ('ALPHA-BETA Alpha Beta', 'alpha-beta'),
    ('Foo foobar bar; x ab cd.', 'foo-bar-ab'),
    ('C++ c++ and c.', 'c++-c'),
    ('Case CASE case-sensitive', 'Case'),
    ('repeat repeat-long long', 'repeat-repeat-long'),
    ('dots a.b and aXb', 'a.b'),
    ('nothing changes except LOWERING', 'xy-z'),
    ('', 'alpha-beta'),
]
for text, name in cases:
    actual = mod.masked(text, name)
    expected = old_masked(text, name)
    assert actual == expected, (text, name, expected, actual)

assert mod.name_tokens('alpha-beta-alpha') == ['alpha-beta-alpha', 'alpha', 'beta']
assert all(len(a) >= len(b) for a, b in zip(mod.name_tokens('a-long-mid'), mod.name_tokens('a-long-mid')[1:]))
assert mod.masked('ab abc x', 'ab-abc') == 'ab x x'  # 2-char part is not masked
assert mod.masked('Case case CASE', 'Case') == 'case case case'  # matching remains case-sensitive after lowercasing

tree = ast.parse(source)
assert [type(n).__name__ for n in tree.body] == ['Import', 'FunctionDef', 'FunctionDef']
assert tree.body[0].names[0].name == 're'
assert [n.name for n in tree.body[1:]] == ['name_tokens', 'masked']
masked_node = tree.body[2]
assert any(isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Name) and n.func.id == 'name_tokens'
           for n in ast.walk(masked_node))
print(f'PASS: compiled; {len(cases)} legacy-equivalence cases; token ordering/deduplication; length filter; case sensitivity; file structure')
